data.commands: After start, construct exactly delta-control.ndjson, delta-candidate.ndjson, iota-control.ndjson and iota-candidate.ndjson from sample-spec.json and source-review.md. Then run python3 explorations/runs/EXPLORE-LAZYLEAN-SEMANTIC-EXTENSION-1/run-screen.py once. It launches each fixture separately on --engine subst and --engine kam, both with --jobs 1 and LL_KAM_MODE=3, under the retained 30-second/2-GiB process-group supervisor.
data.controls: Each family control retains the candidate declarations and value but replaces the targeted reducible final declared type with its direct normal form, so both controls must ACCEPT. Candidate KAM delta or iota must be positive; the delta pair contains a third application declaration that forces KAM weak-head reduction of D, while the substitution summary does not separately count recursor iota. Every cell requires exact unchanged input bytes, recognized output, positive RSS, no timeout or memory breach, and complete cleanup. Missing demand, failed control or unresolved process/parser/resource failure is INCONCLUSIVE. A profile verdict difference under those gates is SIGNAL; matching candidate verdicts are NO_SIGNAL only for this exact sample.
data.question: Can pinned LazyLean v0.3.0 execute one source-supported transparent-definition delta candidate/control pair and one constructor-headed recursor iota candidate/control pair on the substitution and KAM-mode-3 profiles, and does either exact pair produce a profile verdict difference with positive targeted KAM demand?
data.sample: Exactly two declared semantic families and four fresh fixtures: one delta control/candidate pair and one iota control/candidate pair, each launched on subst and KAM-mode-3 for eight planned cells. data.decision: Close the campaign as NO_SIGNAL and do not create an E1 confirmation proposal. Retain the fixtures and supervised raw evidence as exploratory material only. At campaign handoff select the highest-value feasible separate successor and do not start it.
data.limitations: This is an E0 screen over one constructed pair per family and two profiles sharing one implementation; it is not a conformance, correctness, soundness or general no-difference claim. The first sandbox attempt failed before child launch because /bin/ps was denied; the initial host-retry wrapper then failed before child launch on an incorrect literal count. Both failures are preserved and repaired without changing scientific fixtures, profiles or limits.
data.observations: All eight fixed cells completed with ACCEPT: both controls and both candidates on substitution and KAM-mode-3. The KAM delta candidate recorded delta=1 while its control recorded 0; the KAM iota candidate recorded iota=1 while its control recorded 0. Every cell retained unchanged input bytes, exit 0, complete cleanup, one positive RSS sample and no timeout, memory breach or monitor error. Candidate verdicts matched across profiles in both families, so no signal was observed in this exact sample.
